scope: Vectorized positive-root solver for q - z^2 q^(-2h) = 1-t in the monotone h>=0, t<1 regime; this is only the Eq. (4.5) coordinate backbone.
direct_contribution_to_velocity_delivery: Provides the first production primitive needed to evaluate the Eq. (4.5) q/X/eta backbone before implementing v0(X,eta), F(X,eta), U(X,eta) and velocity(points,time).
remaining_limitations: Does not implement X, eta or [u,v,w].
Does not choose or fit v0, F or U profiles.
Does not compare against the OpenAI visualization.
The implemented monotonicity contract is h>=0 and t<1; no claim is made outside that regime.
